title: Python memory leak in request handler causing gradual degradation
symptoms: Memory usage on app servers growing steadily from 200MB to 1.8GB over 6 hours. Response times gradually increasing. Workers eventually killed by OOMKiller. Logs: WARNING Memory usage at 89% — consider restarting workers. No error spikes until workers die.
root_cause: A Python dictionary used as a global LRU cache was not properly bounded. The cache grew without limit because the cache key included request timestamps, making every request a cache miss that added a new entry. After 6 hours: 2 million unique entries consuming 1.6GB.
fix_applied: 1. Restarted gunicorn workers: kill -HUP $(cat gunicorn.pid). 2. Replaced custom dict cache with functools.lru_cache(maxsize=10000). 3. Added explicit cache size limits. 4. Implemented py-spy memory profiling in staging environment. 5. Set gunicorn --max-requests 1000 as safety net.
